Glomerular disease characterized by dominant C1q-containing immune deposits and proteinuria.
Progressive myopathy with ptosis and ophthalmoplegia; persistent swallowing dysfunction in 80-99% and tongue atrophy in 30-79% support oral/GI involvement.
Acquired coagulation factor X deficiency; the supplied definition describes a commonly associated circulating factor X inhibitor.
Mitochondrial respiratory-chain disorder; encephalopathy with seizures in 2/4 and optic atrophy in 2/4. Reported lung disease affects only 1/4.
Cerebellar developmental disease with defining skeletal deformities and frequent bone loss; optic atrophy in 30-79%, ptosis in 80-99%. Skin laxity alone is not damage.
Benign epithelial papilloma of the breast; breast has no axis.
Separation of retinal layers directly threatens visual function; neurological ancestry does not indicate additional brain or nerve disease.
IgG4-mediated periaortic fibroinflammation with large-vessel vasculitis in 30-79%; ureteral encasement causes hydronephrosis and renal insufficiency in 30-79%.
Disease of peripheral autonomic nerves; downstream autonomic symptoms do not establish direct injury of other organs.
Carcinoma of thymic epithelium; thymus has no specified anatomical axis. This is neither lymphoma nor an immune-mediated disease.
Inflammation of paranasal sinus mucosa, generally infectious or immune-mediated; sinuses belong to the pulmonary axis.

Deficient hypothalamic-neurohypophyseal vasopressin synthesis defines an endocrine disorder; polyuria does not establish intrinsic renal injury.
Malignancy of the vulva, a reproductive organ outside the axes; no additional organ involvement is established for the umbrella concept.
Brain abnormalities and intellectual disability with defining craniosynostosis; strabismus in 5/9 and ptosis in 3/9 support ocular dysfunction.
Localized cutaneous amyloid deposition with pigmentary lesions and dry skin in 9/9; no systemic organ injury established.

Tuberculous infection directly involves the urinary bladder; pulmonary involvement is not established by this diagnosis.
Glutamine metabolic disorder defined by encephalopathy, seizures or spastic ataxia. Respiratory failure does not establish direct pulmonary injury across subtypes.
Immune hyperactivation with hemophagocytosis and cytopenias; hepatic inflammation and dysfunction occur in most patients, commonly >50%.
